SOC2-TSC:2017.name: SOC 2 — Trust Services Criteria (OSA)
SOC2-TSC:2017.description: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria: 122 criteria and points of focus from Open Security Architecture. OSA summaries, under CC BY-SA 4.0: https://www.opensecurityarchitecture.org/frameworks/soc2-tsc/ . Formatting changes: source titles split into title and description; complete original wording retained in source_title. No SP 800-53 mappings included. Select the trust-service categories and points of focus appropriate to your engagement; this catalogue does not establish an attestation.
